ADEPTUS CUSTODES model only. Attacks that target an enemy CHARACTER/MONSTER/VEHICLE unit have +1 to wound.
ADEPTUS CUSTODES model only. Gains Emperor’s Light [EXTRA ATTACKS]: Melee, A3, WS2+, S5, AP-2, D2.
ADEPTUS CUSTODES model only. After deployment: redeploy up to 3 friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES units, possibly into strategic reserves.
ADEPTUS CUSTODES model only. The bearer has +1 W. Once per battle, per army, when attacks are allocated to the bearer, it can have a 3+ invulnerable save until the end of the phase.
ADEPTUS CUSTODES model only. The bearer has the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.
ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY model only. Pile-in/consolidation up to 4", any consolidation mode regardless of Before Moving restrictions.

ADEPTUS CUSTODES SHIELD-CAPTAIN model only. Start of your Charge phase: one friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY unit within 6" of this model; if it advanced this turn, that advance does not prevent it from declaring a charge.
ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY/MOUNTED (excluding TERMINATOR models) unit only. Unit has +1 to advance rolls and charge rolls (INFANTRY/MOUNTED, not TERMINATOR).
ADEPTUS CUSTODES model only. Once per battle, per army, at the start of any phase: heals D3+3 wounds.
ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY model only. The unit’s ranged attacks have +1 A.
ADEPTUS CUSTODES model only. Melee weapons equipped by the bearer have the [CLEAVE 1] ability.
ADEPTUS CUSTODES model only. Melee weapons equipped by the bearer have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.
ADEPTUS CUSTODES model only. Gains Auriferous Orb: 12", A3, BS2+, S1, AP0, D1 [ANTI-non-MONSTER/VEHICLE 2+, BLINDING LIGHT, DEVASTATING WOUNDS].
ADEPTUS CUSTODES model only. If the unit charged this turn: re-roll hit rolls and wound rolls of 1.
ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY model only. Attacks that target this unit have -1 to hit rolls.
ADEPTUS CUSTODES model only. Melee weapons equipped by the bearer have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.
ADEPTUS CUSTODES model only. The bearer has the Stealth and Lone Operative abilities.
ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY model only. Once per battle round, per army: a battle-shocked friendly unit within 9" is no longer battle-shocked.
ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY model only. When destroyed, roll D6: on 2+ set it back up unengaged with 3 wounds remaining.
ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY model only. Enemy units making an ingress move cannot be set up within 12" of this unit.
TRUSTED SENTINEL unit only. Once per phase, per unit: target with Heroic Intervention at -1 CP without blocking other uses.
SHIELD-CAPTAIN IN ALLARUS TERMINATOR ARMOUR model only. In your first Movement phase this unit can make an ingress move.
SHIELD-CAPTAIN IN ALLARUS TERMINATOR ARMOUR model only. Once per phase, per army: Rapid Ingress on this unit at -1 CP without blocking other uses.
ADEPTUS CUSTODES DREADNOUGHT unit only. One per army. Melee attacks have +1 A, +1 S and +1 D.
ADEPTUS CUSTODES DREADNOUGHT unit only. This unit has the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.
GRAV-ASSAULT TRANSPORT unit only. When a unit disembarks from this transport: it can re-roll charge rolls and cannot be targeted by snap shooting.
GRAV-ASSAULT unit only. A fall-back move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to shoot.
ANATHEMA PSYKANA model only. +1 to hit rolls, or +1 to hit and wound if it targets a PSYKER/battle-shocked unit.
ANATHEMA PSYKANA model only. Movement phase: one visible enemy within 12" makes a battle-shock roll with -1.

effect.en: A friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit that is not readied becomes readied. Same unit only once per battle round.
After an advance move: ranged attacks have [ASSAULT]; the advance does not prevent declaring a charge.
INFANTRY/MOUNTED: an engaged enemy model that does not target your unit with all its attacks has -1 to hit and -1 to wound.
Ranged attacks: re-roll one hit roll, one wound roll, one damage roll.
Attacks that target your unit (not Custodian Wardens) have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.
Enemy ends a move within 8" of an unengaged TRUSTED SENTINEL: that unit makes a normal move up to D3+3".
INFANTRY selected to fight: melee attacks have [LETHAL HITS: CHARACTER/MONSTER].
Enemy ends a fall-back move: your unengaged INFANTRY within 6" declares a charge (only against units that fell back and are within max distance).
After an enemy unit has fought: your unit within an objective and eligible to fight has Fights First and must be your next unit selected to fight.
Until end of turn, ignore modifiers to M, advance rolls and charge rolls.
Fall-back move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot.
Unengaged unit: one visible enemy within 12" has -1 to its charge rolls when it declares a charge.
Fall-back move does not prevent shooting or declaring a charge.
Ranged attacks that target an enemy unit within 9" have +1 S.
Enemy ends a fall-back move: your INFANTRY that was engaged with it shoots (normal shooting), only that enemy unit.
Your unit’s pile-in move can be up to D3+3".
After an ingress move: until your next turn, attacks targeting your unit have -1 to hit and it cannot be targeted by snap shooting.
After an advance move: it does not prevent your unit from being eligible to declare a charge.
Your unit’s melee attacks can ignore modifiers to hit rolls and wound rolls.
Melee attacks that target a unit with a T greater than your unit’s T have +1 to wound.
Unengaged unit within 6" of an enemy unit declares a charge (charge roll above 6 becomes 6; targets only within 6").
A friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit that is not readied becomes readied. Once per unit per battle round.
Attacks that target your unit (not Custodian Wardens) have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.
Unit (not MONSTER/VEHICLE) controlling an objective: that objective is secured.
After a CHARACTER used a (once per battle, per unit) datasheet ability: use it one additional time, not in the same phase. Once per battle per model.
When a model is destroyed (unit not yet selected to fight): roll D6 (+1 if CHARACTER); on 3+ it stays on the battlefield until the unit has fought.
TRUSTED SENTINEL consolidation: may use the objective consolidation mode regardless of its Before Moving restrictions.
TRUSTED SENTINEL below starting strength: melee attacks (not CHARACTER models) have +2 A.
Enemy ends a move within 8" of an unengaged TRUSTED SENTINEL: normal move up to D3+3".
TERMINATOR unit targeted: attacks that target it have -1 D until that enemy unit has attacked.
TERMINATOR unit with 2+ models splits into separate one-model units.
TERMINATOR unit that made an ingress move this turn: +2 to charge rolls.

text.en: Models in this unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability against mortal wounds.
At the start of the battle round, if a model with this ability is your WARLORD, gain 1CP.

If this unit has the ANATHEMA PSYKANA keyword, models in this unit have the Feel No Pain 3+ ability against Psychic Attacks.

ANATHEMA PSYKANA units with this ability also have:

**Psychic Null (Aura):** While a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit is within 6" of this unit, models in that unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability against Psychic Attacks.

At the start of your Command phase, friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES units with this ability become readied. A readied unit can use one of the ka’tah abilities below at its stated trigger. After using it, that unit is no longer readied. ### Dacatarai WHEN: Start of the Fight phase. TARGET: One friendly readied unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks that target an enemy unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE units) can re-roll hit rolls of 1. ### Kaptaris WHEN: Start of the Fight phase. TARGET: One friendly readied unit. EFFECT: Melee attacks that target your unit have -1 to hit rolls. ### Rendax WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly readied unit is selected to fight. TARGET: One friendly readied unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks have [LETHAL HITS: MONSTER/VEHICLE]. ### Conservai WHEN: Your Command phase. TARGET: One friendly readied unit. EFFECT: Until the end of the turn: - Being engaged/battle-shocked does not prevent your unit from being eligible to start an action. - Starting an action does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot. ### Calistus WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly readied unit is selected to move. TARGET: That readied unit. EFFECT: When your unit makes a normal/advance/fall-back move, your unit can move through all types of model. ### Salvus WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly readied unit is selected to shoot. TARGET: That readied unit. EFFECT: Your unit can ignore modifiers to your unit’s: - BS. - Hit rolls and wound rolls.
In the Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit is selected to fight, its melee attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1] or [LETHAL HITS] (choose one).
ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit (not MONSTER/VEHICLE) within range of an objective: melee attacks targeting it with S greater than its T have -1 to wound.
Select one enemy unit engaged with your unit: it makes a battle-shock roll with -1. Same enemy unit only once per phase.
When a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit makes a fall-back move, it can still be eligible to charge.
Your unit has +2" M.
ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit (not MONSTER/VEHICLE) within range of an objective: ranged attacks targeting it with S greater than its T have -1 to wound.
Your unit’s ranged attacks have +6" R.
Friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES units can re-roll charge rolls.
When an enemy unit engaged with your unit makes a pile-in/consolidation move, -2" from that move.
Friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES units have Fights First.
Until end of turn, advance/fall-back moves do not prevent your unit from being eligible to start an action.
When a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit is selected to attack, its attacks can re-roll one hit roll and one wound roll.
Select one enemy MONSTER/VEHICLE engaged with your unit, roll D6: 1-2 = 1 mortal wound, 3-5 = D3, 6 = 3 mortal wounds.
In your Command phase, select one enemy unit to be a dreadful foe until your next Command phase. ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER attacks against it have +1 to wound.
TRUSTED SENTINEL unit within range of an objective: its attacks can re-roll wound rolls of 1.
At the end of your opponent’s Fight phase, an unengaged ADEPTUS CUSTODES TERMINATOR unit can be placed in strategic reserves.
DREADNOUGHT at starting strength: +2 OC. Below starting strength: re-roll hit rolls of 1. Below half-strength: re-roll hit and wound rolls of 1.
Friendly GRAV-ASSAULT units have 4+ InSv against ranged attacks.

You can select a friendly ANATHEMA PSYKANA CHARACTER as your WARLORD. Friendly PROSECUTOR SQUAD units have BATTLELINE. Friendly ANATHEMA PSYKANA units have Creeping Dread (aura): enemy PSYKER/below-starting-strength units within 12" take battle-shock with -1.
